gates.description: Program charter must be documented and signed off (objective, scope, success criteria, timeline)
Critical path must be identified and monitored across all workstreams
Dependency matrix must be maintained and reviewed weekly
Risk register must be populated with likelihood, impact, owner, and mitigation for each risk
RAG status must be accurate — never report Green when the status is Amber
Milestones must have binary exit criteria (done or not done, no 90% complete)

anti_patterns.description: Spending more time updating project management tools than actually managing the program
Running 2-hour weekly status meetings where each team reads their update out loud
Being the only person who understands the program's dependencies — all knowledge in one head
Accepting every new request without assessing impact on timeline, resources, and dependencies
Noticing a cross-team conflict and hoping it resolves itself — conflicts between teams never self-resolve

escalation_triggers: A critical path dependency is at risk and mitigation options are exhausted
Two workstream leads disagree on priority or resource allocation and facilitation has not resolved it
Program sponsor changes scope or timeline without adjusting resources
A workstream is consistently missing milestones (2+ in a row) despite intervention
Budget overrun exceeds 15% of the program budget
Program risk register shows 3+ high-likelihood, high-impact risks simultaneously

input_requirements.description: Program charter with strategic objective and workstream definitions

output_certifications: Program charter documented and signed off by sponsor
Dependency matrix maintained and reviewed weekly
Risk register populated (likelihood, impact, owner, mitigation)
RAG status accurate (no inflated Green status)
Milestones defined with binary exit criteria
